result:
I have verified the full flow. Here are my findings.

FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.nextStep","claim":"nextStep selects the lowest-idx step whose status is not done/skipped/blocked and whose builds_on/blocks dependencies are all done/skipped; it returns null when no steps remain, {all_blocked:true} when only blocked/dependency-waiting steps remain, or a full step object otherwise","evidence":"src/db.mjs:704-740"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store._unmetDeps","claim":"A step's dependency gate only considers outbound links with relation builds_on or blocks that point to a step (to_step_id) whose status is not done/skipped; plan-level links (to_plan_id only) are ignored and never gate a step","evidence":"src/db.mjs:696-701"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.nextStep","claim":"Blocked steps and dependency-waiting steps are both skipped and reported in skipped_blocked_steps with a reason of 'blocked' or 'dependency' (the latter carrying waiting_on_step_ids), but only for steps with idx lower than the chosen workable step","evidence":"src/db.mjs:714-738"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.readySteps","claim":"readySteps returns every pending, non-blocked step whose deps are satisfied (not just the lowest-idx one), using the same _depsSatisfied gate as nextStep so the two agree by construction","evidence":"src/db.mjs:747-757"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.recordAttempt","claim":"A passing attempt sets the step to done and a failing attempt sets it to failed (still retryable, not blocked); blocked is only set explicitly via setStepStatus","evidence":"src/db.mjs:672-675"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.nextPlan","claim":"nextPlan skips plans with status done/abandoned/blocked and returns the oldest plan whose nextStep yields a workable step (not all_blocked), so blocked plans and all-blocked plans are both bypassed","evidence":"src/db.mjs:466-479"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/server.mjs#next_step tool","claim":"The next_step tool maps nextStep's three shapes to directives: null → set_plan_status done + next_plan; all_blocked → set_plan_status blocked + next_plan; a step → set_step_status in_progress, work, record_attempt, then call next_step again","evidence":"src/server.mjs:140-181"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/server.mjs#set_step_status tool","claim":"Setting a step to blocked returns a directive to write_carry_forward the unblock note then call next_step, since blocked steps are skipped by nextStep","evidence":"src/server.mjs:718-722"}]

VERDICT: pass — verified how Store.nextStep picks the lowest-idx workable step, gates on builds_on/blocks deps, and skips/reports blocked and dependency-waiting steps, plus the server-side directives that drive progression past them.
